result.title: Physically Interpretable Basin Selection in Discrete-Variable Origami Design
result.summary: Automatic differentiation has enabled rapid progress on continuous-variable mechanical design problems, but gradient-based optimization still struggles with discrete variables. The standard approach is to optimize using a continuous relaxation of the choices, then commit to the nearest discrete design at the end. Why this procedure selects unfavorable basins is poorly understood. Here, we introduce a practical, interpretable design problem inspired by origami, in which automatic differentiation is used to design shapes with a target functional behavior. Each origami sheet has a fixed geometry, and a bilevel optimization framework tunes which one of four discrete hinge types to place at each fold. Baseline gradient-based design settles into basins with a large discretization gap: relaxed optimization solves 97% of runs, but the final, discrete solutions succeed only half the time. We find that the gap can be relieved with a surprisingly simple modification. An initialization prior uniformly biased toward the stiff, flat hinge option boosts the final solve fraction from 49% to 69%. Applying the prior adds no additional compute and leaves the optimization process unchanged. Compared to the baseline, sheets produced with the prior have greater geometric compatibility and mechanical stiffness. Directly penalizing frustration and floppiness in the outer loss function produces an even greater improvement than the prior does, raising the solve fraction to 78% and indicating that these properties help distinguish the unfavorable basins. Our results demonstrate that loss landscapes for mechanical design can have physically meaningful basins that are not robust to discretization and cause solves to fail. Targeting these basins' physical signatures, even with just an initialization bias, helps avoid them.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究折纸折叠处四类离散铰链的选择设计：用双层优化与连续松弛加梯度优化求解，发现松弛阶段成功但提交为离散设计后约半数失败，并提出均匀偏向刚性平铰链的初始化先验与对外层损失直接惩罚「frustration/floppiness」来避开不利盆地。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「连续松弛优化→离散提交」的落差与损失地形中可解释盆地、初始化先验的分析，可能为 latent 连续推理状态解码为离散决策时的优化地形与监督设计提供概念类比，联系较远，可供核查。
